title_en: 11oz Coffee Mug, All-Over Print Reindeer and Snowflakes Ceramic Cup, Full Wrap Around Design, 5 Interior Colors, Dishwasher & Microwave Safe, Gift for Coffee Lovers
bullets_en: FULL WRAP AROUND PRINT - the artwork runs edge to edge around the whole mug, so the scene continues from every angle with no blank white panel

SEAMLESS ALL-OVER DESIGN - folk-style reindeer with branching antlers stepping in rows over a deep green ground, scattered with antique gold snowflakes, stars and small berry accents, printed in deep forest green, cranberry red, warm cream and antique gold with crisp long-lasting detail
5 INTERIOR COLORS - choose White, Black, Pink, Red or Blue interior; glossy white exterior suits every kitchen and desk
PREMIUM 11oz CERAMIC - 11 oz / 330 ml, food-grade glaze, safe for dishwasher and microwave
GIFT-READY - a warm present for coffee lovers, coworkers, teachers and hostesses
description_en:
A full wrap design, not a small front print: reindeer stepping in tidy rows over forest-green ground, flecked with gold snowflakes, stars and berries. The artwork circles this 11 oz ceramic mug from handle to handle, so there is no blank side and no white gap. A restrained retro palette keeps it easy to live with on a desk or an open shelf.

Glossy white body with your choice of interior color, a comfortable C-shaped handle, and a print baked for long-lasting color. Dishwasher and microwave safe. Packed securely for safe delivery.

A quiet, illustrated mug for slow mornings, and an easy gift for anyone who likes their coffee with a scene.
